notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.79.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Sua loi bam "Ap dung vao model" bao "Da ghi 0 type" ma noi dung khong vao model: o file mau moi, ghi chu Bao gia / BOQ cua type cua dang gan vao global parameter dung chung (vi du Cua-BGia_CuonNhom) nen tham so type bi khoa. - Khi sua noi dung cua dong dang gan global parameter, addin hoi 1 lan cho dong do: + Sua chung: ghi vao global parameter, moi type gan chung doi theo (luoi cap nhat ngay cac dong cung nhom). + Tach rieng: go lien ket global parameter cua rieng type do (noi dung va ban dich di cap) roi ghi gia tri rieng.
